canonical_sources: user directive 2026-05-01: fast webnovel pacing; one TR block is 2-6 episodes; every block needs at least one additional incident beat; protagonist acts by self-interest, profit, and efficiency
core_materials: Opening representative spike: all evaluators see broken refrigerated trucks, but Do-yoon proves the cold-chain certification and recall insurance trigger are still alive.

First reward retention: meeting seat, 24-hour data-room access, insurer preliminary recognition, bank direct line, ten-day exclusive diligence, priority negotiation, and next data-room invitation must remain visible across the opening bundle.
Authority gain route: disposable field examiner -> meeting-room participant -> bank/insurer contact -> exclusive diligence holder -> priority negotiator -> next distressed-deal invitee.
Opening macro battlefield: 삼진콜드 cold-chain distressed sale, spanning creditor committee, data room, warehouse logs, insurer clause dispute, buyer call, port cold-storage priority, and SPV bid table.

Core asset anatomy: cold-chain certification, dawn delivery route, recall insurance claim, port cold-storage priority use, delivery claim records, driver route memory, and refrigerated-truck scrap pressure.
Clean acquisition path: advisory conflict must be cleared by advisory exit, public bid, creditor approval, court schedule, or SPV separation before acquisition becomes story truth.

Repeatable loop: bankrupt notice -> market sees liquidation value -> Do-yoon finds living rights -> present proof -> same-block receipt -> clean rights acquisition -> cashflow/authority -> larger bankrupt deal.
Self-interest law: Do-yoon keeps people and operations only when they preserve certification, route memory, claim defense, execution speed, leverage, or next-gate position.
TR pacing law: each block is a 2-6 episode bundle and needs at least two incident beats plus a same-block receipt.
Rights-before-cash reward grammar: early blocks pay with access, authority, legal receipt, protection, exclusivity, and next-gate position before large money.
npc_pool: 한도윤 - 회귀한 구조조정 실사관; 부도 회사 안의 살아 있는 권리를 사는 self-interested operator.
회계법인 파트너 - 도윤의 현장 proof를 자기 성과로 가로채려는 상사; 빠른 보고서 납품과 책임 회피가 동기.
채권은행 구조조정팀장 - 빠른 청산과 감사 리스크 회피를 우선하는 문지기; proof가 회수율을 올리면 태도를 바꾼다.
보험사 손해사정 담당자 - 리콜 보험금 지급을 늦추거나 축소하려는 상대; 약관과 온도 로그가 맞물리면 방어가 약해진다.
대형마트 구매담당자 - 새벽 배송 공백을 두려워하는 외부 평가자; Do-yoon의 권리 묶음이 운영 리스크를 줄이면 협상선이 된다.
삼진콜드 창고장 또는 운송반장 - 감정적 구원 대상이 아니라 route memory와 certification 유지에 필요한 실행 자산.
고철업자 또는 scrap buyer - 빠른 폐차 일괄매입으로 살아 있는 권리를 묻으려는 초반 방해자.
대형 PEF 파트너 - 후반에 Do-yoon의 검증된 회생 포트폴리오를 싸게 흡수하려는 상위 포식자.
crisis_pool: 삼진콜드가 이번 주 안에 고철 매각으로 넘어가며 certification, route, insurance claim, port priority가 흩어질 위기.
채권단이 담보 회수와 감사 리스크 때문에 빠른 청산을 밀어붙이는 압박.
보험사가 온도 이탈 기록과 리콜 약관의 지급 트리거를 부정하는 지급 회피.
회계법인 파트너가 Do-yoon의 proof를 가로채거나 누락 책임을 전가하는 내부 압박.
고철업자가 냉동차 일괄매입으로 인증 승계와 route proof를 묻으려는 외부 방해.
대형마트 buyer가 배송 공백을 이유로 노선 자체를 경쟁사로 넘기려는 deadline.
SPV 인수 구조가 이해상충 또는 내부정보 거래로 오해받을 수 있는 legality risk.
핵심 기사 또는 창고장이 떠나 route memory와 certification maintenance가 무너지는 execution risk.
hard_constraints: No TR before Stage 0, Phase 0, and work_guard freeze.
No BI before accepted TR draft.
Every TR block must be treated as roughly 2-6 downstream episodes, not one episode.
Every TR block must contain at least two distinct incident beats and a same-block receipt.
Do-yoon's actions must be legible as profit, efficiency, legal protection, speed, leverage, defense, retaliation, survival, or next-gate position.
Do-yoon does not secretly acquire assets while holding live advisory conflict; legal receipt is mandatory.
Opening 2-6 cannot use block 1 or block 7+ as delayed rescue.
Early rewards must be authority/access/legal receipt before large cash.
No charity-rescue engine; saving people or operations must preserve value or accelerate execution.
do_not_fake: Do not fake cold-chain certification mechanics as vague business aura.
Do not fake insurance payout with a generic phone call; use clause, trigger, log, claim, or preliminary recognition language.
Do not fake creditor approval; show meeting seat, data-room access, exclusivity, priority negotiation, court schedule, or bid condition.
Do not fake logistics operation; use route memory, temperature logs, delivery claim timing, port allocation, driver availability, or cold-storage priority.
Do not handwave conflict-of-interest; advisory exit, public bid, creditor approval, court schedule, or SPV separation must appear.
Do not replace deal proof with future-knowledge monologue.
Do not turn staff retention into saintly rescue; it must defend certification, route memory, claim proof, or execution speed.
Do not pay a block with praise only; pay with authority, access, legal protection, cashflow, or next-gate position.
manual_audit_note:
1. Ready material: canon pitch, checklist audit, first-block ledger, legal acquisition guard, self-interest law, opening macro battlefield, and Stage0 profile route are all directly usable for Phase 0.
2. Remaining gaps: exact company names beyond 삼진콜드, court/bank procedural details, insurance clause wording, port/cold-storage institutional names, and later-arc deal specifics should be enriched in Phase 0 or TR, not faked loosely.
3. Do-not-fake risk: logistics, insurance, creditor approval, and conflict-of-interest surfaces must be shown as document/authority receipts rather than generic consulting scenes.
